episodes.title: Hiccup Bubbles! 🫧 | Drizzle & Pudge
episodes.logline: Drizzle's hiccups fill the meadow with bubbles, one floats Bitsy the ladybug up into the sky, and the friends gently bring her back down.
episodes.description: Drizzle hiccups bubbles and Bitsy floats away. Can Pudge help? A wordless cartoon for little ones, new episode every day.

shots.keyframe: Drizzle floating happily above Pudge in the sunny meadow, both smiling
shots.action: Drizzle hiccups and a stream of shiny bubbles pops out of her; Pudge claps and chases them

shots.keyframe: Pudge popping bubbles with one finger, Bitsy sitting on a daisy watching
shots.action: a big bubble drifts down over Bitsy and lifts her up into the air inside it, Bitsy waves her tiny arms
shots.camera: close on Bitsy then tilt up
shots.sfx: soft whoosh, tiny surprised squeak, Pudge gasps 'uh-oh!'

shots.keyframe: Bitsy's bubble floating high among fluffy clouds, Drizzle zooming up after it
shots.action: Drizzle catches up and cuddles the bubble gently in her cloud arms
shots.camera: wide sky shot, Drizzle flying in

shots.keyframe: Drizzle floating down slowly, Pudge holding out his paws below
shots.action: the bubble lands softly in Pudge's paws and pops, Bitsy is safe and hugs Pudge's nose
shots.sfx: soft pop, happy giggles, little buzz

shots.keyframe: Drizzle drips a perfect round shiny puddle on the ground, Pudge crouching ready to jump
shots.action: Pudge jumps into the puddle with both feet, water splashes up in a sparkly crown, everyone laughs and waves at the camera
shots.camera: low wide angle, slow motion on the splash
shots.sfx: big happy splash in slow motion, both giggle 'yay!', sparkly chime

episodes.loop_note: ends on the Puddle Jump; loops to the opening

episodes.description: Pudge's flowers need water but Drizzle is all puffed out. A giggle saves the day! A wordless cartoon for little ones, new episode every day.

shots.keyframe: Pudge looking sadly at a row of droopy flowers in the hot sun

shots.keyframe: Drizzle squeezing her cheeks trying to rain, Pudge watching hopefully
shots.action: Drizzle squeezes, only one tiny drop falls, she sighs and goes flat

shots.keyframe: Pudge putting a flower pot on his head like a hat and pulling a funny face
shots.action: Pudge waddles like a penguin with the pot on his head; Drizzle starts to giggle

shots.keyframe: Drizzle laughing so hard she wobbles, rain pouring from her

shots.keyframe: Drizzle drips a perfect round shiny puddle on the ground, Pudge crouching ready to jump

shots.keyframe: Drizzle sniffing a big sunflower, nose twitching, Pudge standing next to her

shots.keyframe: Pudge on the grassy bank looking at his rainbow reflection in the pond

shots.keyframe: Gran Tortle pointing to her plain wooden fence, Drizzle and Pudge ready
shots.action: Drizzle sneezes one colour at a time onto the fence as Pudge points: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, making a rainbow; Gran claps

shots.camera: low wide angle, slow motion on the splash
shots.sfx: big happy splash in slow motion, both giggle 'yay!', sparkly chime
